content.heading: Questions about automation.
content.lead: Straight answers to what founders ask before we automate anything. If yours is not here, ask us.

faq.q: What if the AI gets something wrong?
faq.a: A person checks the work. Every automation has an owner and a backup plan, and anything the AI is unsure about goes to a person before it is saved.

faq.q: Which tools do you work with?
faq.a: The ones you already use. We connect your software with tools like Make, n8n and Zapier, and where a system has no easy way in, AI operates it the way a person would.

faq.q: What do we pay for AI usage?
faq.a: What it costs. Model fees are passed on with no markup and shown on their own line of your invoice, with the provider’s usage report attached.
You do. You own everything we build, including the code and the documentation, written clearly enough for a new hire to follow.

faq.q: What if AI is not the answer?
faq.a: We say so. If an off-the-shelf tool or a simpler fix costs you less, we will tell you, even when it means less work for us.
It stays in your systems wherever possible. We ask only for the access the work needs, and we never use your data to train anything you don’t own.
